title: Optometrist
description:
**Company Description**
TwoLens is a fast-paced eyewear company focused on delivering high-quality prescription glasses in just 15 minutes, eliminating long wait times for customers. The brand combines modern style with precision optics, ensuring that every frame supports the customer’s daily life, whether they are students, professionals, or anyone needing quick, reliable vision solutions. TwoLens is built on the belief that getting the right eyewear should be simple, efficient, and tailored to individual needs. By prioritizing speed without compromising quality, the company helps people not only see better, but see faster.

**Role Description**
The Optometrist at TwoLens will provide comprehensive eye examinations, accurately assess visual acuity, and determine appropriate prescriptions for customers. Day-to-day responsibilities include performing refractions, conducting basic eye health screenings, advising customers on lens options and frame suitability, and ensuring prescriptions are suitable for rapid on-site fulfillment. The Optometrist will collaborate closely with the in-store team to maintain high standards of clinical accuracy, customer experience, and workflow efficiency. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Yelahanka, requiring consistent in-person interaction with customers and team members.

**Qualifications**

* Licensed Optometrist with a recognized degree or diploma in Optometry and eligibility to practice in the region.
* Strong clinical skills in refraction, basic ocular health assessment, and prescription verification.
* Ability to explain findings and recommendations clearly to customers, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced retail or clinical environment, with attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Customer-focused mindset, with the ability to provide empathetic, inclusive, and respectful service to diverse individuals.
* Willingness to collaborate with store staff, adapt to streamlined processes, and support rapid turn-around of eyewear.
* Prior experience in optical retail or eye care settings is an advantage.
* Basic computer skills for maintaining records, using digital tools, and managing prescriptions.

Salary: 3LPA to 5 LPA

title: Employee Experience & Continuous Improvement Lead
description:
Business Unit: ESI HQ & Other
  
  
Division: IT - Business
  
  
**Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future!**
Element Solutions Inc (NYSE:ESI) is a leading specialty chemicals company whose operating businesses formulate a broad range of solutions that enhance the performance of products people use every day. Developed in multi-step technological processes, our innovative solutions enable our customer manufacturing processes in several key segments, including electronic circuitry, communication infrastructure, automotive systems, industrial surface finishing, and offshore energy.
  
  
Customers of our businesses use our innovation as a competitive advantage, relying on us to help them navigate in fast-paced, high-growth markets. For example, in-care technology, from infotainment to driver assistance, is accelerating the paste of new product development and automotive markets, and with a deep market expertise in electronics, we sit at the intersection of the fast-growing market, changing the competitive playing field for automotive manufacturers, with a long-standing presence.
  
  
We strive to embody the five 'Elements of our Culture'- our '5C's'; Challenge, Commit, Collaborate, Choose, and Care. These core values are the foundation of our organization which our employees embrace in their interactions with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders, to drive financial performance and create a rewarding work environment.
  
  
**Who are we looking for?**
The Employee Experience & Continuous Improvement Lead improves how employees experience IT services and internal processes. The role turns employee feedback, service performance data and operational pain points into practical, measurable improvements. Working across IT and business functions, the position leads service-quality reviews, root-cause analysis and cross-functional improvement initiatives, with a strong focus on sustainable adoption and business outcomes.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
**Employee Experience And Service Quality**
Own the review of negative satisfaction surveys and other employee feedback relating to IT services.
  
  
Coordinate fact-based reviews with service owners, identify root causes and agree on corrective or service-recovery actions.
  
  
Analyze recurring themes across employee feedback, service interactions and key employee journeys, including onboarding, offboarding, access, and support.
  
  
Advocate for clear, consistent and user-friendly service experiences, communications and processes.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and benefits review.
  
  
Facilitate process mapping, root-cause analysis, and solution-design workshops.
  
  
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL or comparable methods to simplify processes, reduce waste, and improve quality.
  
  
Partner with service and process owners to prioritize actions, manage dependencies, and sustain improvements.
  
  
**Insights, Measurement and Change**
Define and monitor employee experience, service quality, and improvement of KPIs.
  
  
Prepare concise trend reports and recommendations for leadership and service owners.
  
  
Track improvement commitments, benefits, and post-implementation outcomes.
  
  
Support communications, readiness, training, and stakeholder engagement for process changes.
  
  
**Role Boundaries**
The role focuses on employee experience, service quality, and continuous improvement, not system delivery.
  
  
Technology platforms are used as information or workflow sources when relevant.
  
  
**Who are You?**

* 3-5 years of experience in continuous improvement, employee or customer experience, service quality, operational excellence, process management, or business transformation.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives and influencing without direct authority.
* Experience analyzing qualitative feedback and operational data, conducting root-cause analysis, and translating findings into action.
* Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or ITIL; certification is preferred.
* Experience with survey analysis, KPI reporting, or tools such as Power BI, servicenow is an advantage.

**What competencies will you need?**

* Ability to perform data analysis and use statistical tools.
* Ability to communicate complex problems in plain language.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.
* Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

**We are Offering...**
**Teamwork**
- At Element Solutions Inc, you will be part of a highly collaborative culture that promotes continuous improvement through cross-functional partnerships to achieve our mission. We do this through a strong and unified culture and transparent management which has empowered us to create high performing global teams that achieve superior solutions for our customers.
  
  
**Innovative**
- At ESI, we are committed to solving the complex and evolving needs of our customers through innovation and high-quality standards. We are focused on bringing cutting-edge and environmentally sustainable solutions to the market. Our people are the critical resources required to make that happen. We support your success by creating a strong, inclusive culture, competitive total rewards, and an appropriate work-life balance.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category applicable under federal, state and local laws.

title: Website Manager
description:
**Organisation Name:**
One World One Family Mission

**Job Title:**
Website Manager

**Location:**
Muddenahalli, Karnataka

**About Us:**

One World One Family Mission provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.

**About the Mission’s websites**

1. Mission Website - The Mission has its own website which provides an overview of the mission and the member organisations worldwide. This is managed by the Mission Website Team.

1. Parent Trusts and Foundations - In addition to this, there are parent trusts and foundations in India that primarily focus on specific verticals (Health, Education, Nutrition). Many of these organisations have their own websites, which are managed by dedicated website teams, while others are managed by the Mission Website Team.

1. Institutional Websites - The Mission also manages multiple institutions such as Hospitals, Schools, Colleges and Universities. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.

1. Country Websites - For countries in which our organisation has a presence, some of them have their own websites. Many of these countries do not have a website. However, for those that do, their websites are managed by local teams. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.

The Mission is currently undergoing a rebranding phase wherein we are consolidating and enhancing the existing websites to ensure that it is clear to website visitors that all these websites fall under one Mission.

**Position Description**

The Website Manager will be responsible for the management, maintenance and enhancement of the key websites under the
**One World One Family Mission**
. The role will ensure that all websites remain accurate, up-to-date, secure, user-friendly, and aligned with the mission's vision, values, and objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Website Management & Operations**

* Manage and oversee all websites under the One World One Family Mission.
* Ensure websites are regularly updated with relevant and accurate content.
* Monitor website functionality, performance, and availability.
* Maintain consistency in design, branding, content, and user experience across all mission websites.
* Implement website enhancement initiatives and support new website launches when required.
* For mission websites that are managed by other individuals and parties, the Website Manager is responsible for providing support, guidance and instructions to ensure that these websites maintain a standard of care, quality and professionalism and are in line with the Mission’s branding guidelines.
* Initiate and manage a dashboard or ticketing system for managing website updates.

**2. Content Management**

* Coordinate with departments, project teams, and content owners to collect and publish website content.
* Establish a systematic review process to ensure information remains current and relevant.
* Update news, events, announcements, programs, reports, and other digital content regularly.
* Ensure content follows organisational guidelines and quality standards.
* In areas where there are no existing processes or guidelines, the Website Manager is responsible for defining and developing new processes/guidelines.

**3. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as the central point of contact for all website-related requirements.
* Collaborate with mission leaders, departments, partners, and external vendors for website updates and improvements.
* Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable website enhancements.
* Facilitate periodic review meetings to address website needs and priorities.

**4. Website Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct regular audits of website content, links, forms, and functionality.
* Ensure compliance with organisational standards, accessibility requirements, and digital best practices.
* Maintain documentation related to website structures, processes, and update logs.
* Ensure information accuracy and consistency across all websites.

**5. Technical Coordination**

* Liaise with developers, hosting providers, and IT teams for website maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Monitor website security, backups, software updates, and performance optimization.
* Coordinate implementation of new features, integrations, and technical improvements.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues affecting website operations.

**6. Analytics & Reporting**

* Monitor website traffic, engagement, and performance metrics.
* Generate periodic reports on website usage and effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations to improve user experience, engagement, and website performance.
* Track the impact of digital initiatives and content updates.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of experience in website management, digital communications, or related roles, including at least 2 years in a role leading or supervising a team.
* Extensive experience working with Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with website analytics and digital marketing tools.

**Required Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong working knowledge of website technologies, hosting, and security practices, sufficient to liaise confidently with developers and IT teams and troubleshoot issues independently where possible. Solid understanding of SEO, accessibility standards, and digital best practices.
* Able to work on tight deadlines to ensure websites are updated on a timely basis and establish/adhere to agreed SLA timelines.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a small team, including delegating responsibilities, setting priorities, and building team capability over time.
* Able to confidently communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to collaborate with other teams, including the content team, institutional leadership, design team, branding team and social media team.
* Able to manage multiple websites and priorities simultaneously.

**Location/Work Environment:**
This is a full-time on-site job role.

**Why Join Us?**

Joining the OWOF mission offers a chance to impact marginalized communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.

title: 3D Operator
description:
**Company Description**
Creative Consultants is a growing organization focused on delivering high-quality design and visualization solutions for a diverse range of clients. The company values innovation, accuracy, and collaboration, and works closely with partners to bring technical and creative ideas to life. Team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise in design, 3D visualization, and project execution to support client goals. Creative Consultants offers an environment where individuals can develop their skills, work on varied projects, and participate in continuous improvement of processes and outcomes.
  
**Role Description**
The 3D Operator will be responsible for creating, modifying, and optimizing 3D models and visualizations for client projects. Day-to-day tasks include interpreting design plans and specifications, preparing accurate 3D layouts, and collaborating with designers, engineers, and project managers to ensure alignment with project requirements. The role also involves maintaining organized project files, performing quality checks on 3D outputs, and ensuring that all deliverables meet internal and client standards. This is a full-time, on-site role located in Devanahalli, requiring close coordination with the local team and adherence to project schedules and timelines.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong 3D modeling and visualization skills using relevant software tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, or similar).
* Candidates should possess skills in reading and interpreting technical drawings, plans, and specifications, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Candidates should possess skills in project coordination, including organizing files, managing multiple tasks, and meeting deadlines.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with multidisciplinary teams and respond to feedback constructively.
* Candidates should possess basic computer literacy and the ability to learn new design and visualization tools as needed.
* A diploma or degree in architecture, engineering, interior design, or a related field is beneficial.
* Prior experience in a 3D operator, draftsperson, or visualization role, especially in construction or design environments, is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Devanahalli and maintain professional conduct in client-facing and team interactions.

description:
BetaNXT
   

  

 The Company

We focused on solving our customers most demanding integration challenges with flexible, efficient, connected solutions. Our products reduce enterprise cost, streamline operation processes, increase advisor productivity, and enhances the investor experience. Together with BetaNXT, wealth management firms are transforming their platforms into differentiating assets that enable scale and commercial growth.
   

  

 But we're not just invested in our customers; we're also invested in people. We know that our overall success is a combined effort, and we therefore strive to provide opportunities for our employees to learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 BETA is a self\-clearing securities processing solution for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands\-on experience, BETA provides critical back\-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Associate with hands\-on experience in production\-level, cloud\-hosted data\-as\-a\-service application. In this role, you will primarily work on data warehousing\- involving data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL processes including hands on in Data Build Tool (DBT) or any such build tools. You will be responsible for querying using SQL,write functions and stored procedures, and more. On any given day, you might be architecting data ingestion and warehousing solutions, and delivering data to our customers or internal applications through queries and functions. You will follow best practices in code and design, secure coding practices, and review data architecture, modeling, and queries from development through to completion in a live production environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development , this role is part of a Scrum team for developing product (s) within the Data Platform team . The role will be involved with developing customer facing cloud hosted data as service products . This role necessitates meetings and require heavy collaboration within and across many teams . Our business model is hybrid, working from our B angalore campus.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement data ingestion and warehousing solutions.
* Develop and maintain data models, ETL, and reverse ETL processes.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
* Ensure best practices in code and design, including secure coding practices.
* Review and improve data architecture, modeling, and queries.
* Deliver data solutions to customers and internal applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to meet project goals.


 Your Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in a data\-related software engineering role.
* Experience in Snowflake, DBT models.
* Hands\-on experience with coding, analytical, and data querying knowledge.
* Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle and Agile software development.
* Solid design knowledge to create extensible, reusable data deliveries that meet architectural objectives and security assessments.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and quickly get up to speed.
* Ability to work autonomously and in teams.
* Excitement for new technologies and challenges of scale.
* Proficiency in:
* Data Build Tool (DBT) or any analogous tool
* Data warehousing, including data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL
* SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures
* Various data delivery methodologies (files, streams, APIs)
* Understanding of data\-related application SDKs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools like Terraform.
* Familiarity with AWS
* Knowledge of programming languages such as Python and PowerShell.


 As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. Therefore we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world−regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law.

title: Media Consultant
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission passionately provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across more than 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Join our dynamic team as a Media Consultant, where you will spearhead our PR and media initiatives, driving awareness and support for our impactful causes. This role offers a unique opportunity to utilise your expertise in media strategy, forge partnerships with key stakeholders, and leverage various platforms to amplify the organisation’s message and mission.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop and implement comprehensive media strategies to enhance brand visibility and support organisational objectives.
* Cultivate relationships with editors, journalists, and news channels to secure coverage and promote the organisation’s initiatives.
* Pitch compelling story ideas and press releases to secure positive coverage of organisation's initiatives, events, and milestones.
* Monitor media coverage and industry trends to identify opportunities for strategic engagement and proactive outreach.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with internal teams to ensure alignment of messaging and maximise media impact.
* Provide media training and support to spokespeople and staff members as needed.
* Develop and implement crisis communication plans to effectively manage and mitigate reputational risks in the event of negative media coverage or emergencies.
* Track and analyse media metrics to measure the effectiveness of PR efforts and inform future strategies.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and platforms to innovate media tactics and maintain relevance in a rapidly evolving landscape.
* Develop and manage the annual media budget, allocating resources strategically to maximise ROI and achieve organisational goals.
* Track expenditures and performance against budget targets, providing regular updates and recommendations for adjustments as needed.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
* Proven experience of 6\-8 years in media relations, PR, or journalism, with a focus on strategic planning and execution.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong network of media contacts across print, broadcast, and digital platforms.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated success in securing media coverage and generating positive publicity for organisations or causes.
* Strategic thinker with a creative mindset and the ability to generate innovative ideas for media campaigns.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Experience working in multicultural or international settings, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Adherence to organisational policies and guidelines, including those related to media relations, privacy, and data protection.
* Proficiency in media monitoring tools, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Passion for social impact and a commitment to the organisation’s mission and values.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* None specified.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 This is a full\-time, work from office based role.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across more than 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
